title: GIS Ad Hoc Analyses
text: A working index of small, one-off GIS analyses for WFRC. Each analysis lives in its own folder under projects/, with its own data sources, script/notebook, and outputs. See README.md and CLAUDE.md at the repo root for conventions, and projects/_template/ as the starting point for a new analysis.

title: GIS Ad Hoc Analyses
text:
Analyses

_template – example page proving the ArcGIS REST -> geopandas -> Quarto pipeline. Copy this folder to start a real analysis.
